entities.name: Delfim de Pádua Peixoto Filho
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Delfim de Pádua Peixoto Filho, known as Delfim Peixoto, was a Brazilian politician and football administrator who died as a result of the crash of LaMia Airlines Flight 2933. At the time of his death he was a vice president of the Brazilian Football Confederation (CBF) and president of the Federação Catarinense de Futebol (FCF), a position he had held since 1985.
